skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Appreciate Fragrance
skins.content: EPOQUE Series New Release/Appreciate Fragrance. Finely-crafted Victorian dress, handmade from the finest materials. An elegant and dignified outfit bound to garner attention anywhere.
skins.quote: War has taken its last breath. Blood and steel have been overgrown by vegetation, and bright flowers bloom in place of hate.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA317
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA317. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: She hopes for a day where everyone can have the right to freely enjoy the beach and sun.
